title: The bench on Bang, hours before Nvidia
dek: Sixteen lenses, one disagreement: wait for 71.7–72.4k, or let PCE and Warsh decide. Pre-positioning is the error.

title: His short is already dead
dek: Bang’s August card: 66.5k short delivered, 62.2k long missed, 78.5k short stopped. He wants 71.7–72.4k next. Spot is not there yet.

title: A second probe of eighty
dek: Monday afternoon retested the round number. A wick is not a Daily close. Cash Cat ripped anyway.

title: The crash is a window, not a date
dek: A full-bench read after Bitcoin’s five-day squeeze. Local panic clusters around events. It does not print on a slogan.
